test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Knowing that building the new park in the city centre would be a controversial issue, the mayor's office decided to let the public _________ with their concerns.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Weigh in'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Weigh in" **means to contribute one's opinion or perspective on a matter, especially when it's significant or controversial.
 
• In this context, the mayor's office decided to allow the public to express their concerns regarding the building of the new park in the city center.
 
• This option effectively conveys the idea of soliciting public input or opinions.
 
• Hence the correct answer is **'Weigh in'.**

​Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 4'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **fill up **- This option doesn't accurately convey the idea of expressing opinions or concerns. "Fill up" usually means to make something full or complete, such as filling up a container with liquid.
 
• **size up** - This option means to assess or evaluate something, often in terms of its worth or quality. While it could be related to considering opinions, it doesn't directly convey the idea of providing input or expressing concerns.
 
• 
 
**beat to** - This option doesn't make sense in this context. "Beat to" doesn't have a relevant meaning in relation to allowing the public to express their concerns. It seems out of place in this sentence.
